claims.text: Every Asset F member's Wells/ICIT identity is pinned in the step-0 record at gate 0.3.
claims.boundary: The identity is the ICIT sign code as it appears in the pinned Shakti corpus file. The step-0 record names the basis file or files, pins each by SHA-256, and records per member the basis entry the identity was read from. Carried from the draft text: a member that cannot be identified on that basis is named UNIDENTIFIED IN ICIT with the basis gap stated; it is never silently dropped and never substituted, it is not counted as TOO THIN, and its disposition is the one ruled at the freeze (OPEN-072-2; draft-proposed ruling DD-072-5: excluded from both populations' weighting, reported in the headline block with its share of the identified family's occurrences); if no member can be identified, the run closes as CONCORDANCE FAILED. The held basis candidates are named in spec section 2; the yajnadevam_to_parpola crosswalk basis is partial by its own record (184 confirmed mappings of 592 glyphs), so unidentified members are a designed-for case, not an anomaly. Freeze act (OPEN-072-2, 2026-10-22): the governing basis is CONFIRMED as two held files, each pinned by SHA-256 - data/crosswalks/canonical_sign_registry.csv (8a0b2a82ac8d226d574ce01f5550c581efd91a97cab86201a62f7a7e435bd420) and data/crosswalks/yajnadevam_to_parpola_crosswalk.csv (e44b8b550155e3d071e7fc5f94e8c98e9755de437c99e2f5027e3d647b2950a2). The stated rule: keyed by the member's Parpola number, the member's ICIT identity is the unique code in the intersection of the registry row's wells_ids and the glyph ids of the crosswalk's confirmed rows whose best_parpola_match is that Parpola number; if the intersection does not hold exactly one code, the member is UNIDENTIFIED IN ICIT. sign_crosswalk_master.csv was considered and does not govern: it carries no Wells/ICIT code. The programme's curated Mahadevan-Parpola crosswalk (spec section 2) was considered and does not govern the ICIT identity: its wells_id values (W008-W042 for this family) appear in neither basis file and codes 008-042 are absent or near-absent in the pinned corpus. Result: M048 to ICIT 243 (registry W243; crosswalk glyph 243, confirmed), M050 to ICIT 220 (W220; glyph 220, confirmed), M060 to ICIT 235 (W235; glyph 235, confirmed), M145 to ICIT 032 (W032; glyph 32, confirmed - the crosswalk's second glyph for P145, 600, is assigned by the registry to P262 and is not in the intersection), M147 to ICIT 033 (W033; glyph 33, confirmed). UNIDENTIFIED IN ICIT: M047 (registry carries two wells_ids, W517 and W518, and the crosswalk has no confirmed row for P047 - the intersection is empty) and M052 (registry carries W944 alone, and the crosswalk has no confirmed row for P052 - the intersection is empty). Disposition, CONFIRMED as DD-072-5 proposed: each unidentified member is named in the headline block, excluded from both populations' weighting, never dropped silently and never substituted; its share of the family's occurrences in ICIT space cannot be measured (it has no ICIT identity to count), and the records state that plainly instead of the draft's share wording. Named divergence, for the record: the registry's depiction notes for P145 and P147 (stroke signs) and for P047 (not a fish depiction) differ from Asset F's depiction notes for the same Parpola numbers; the concordance is a numbering concordance on the stated basis, membership remains Asset F's exactly as frozen, and the divergence is reported, not smoothed. Restated at freeze recovery round 2: the identities are stated on the concordance basis the freeze confirmed (stated in full in this boundary). Restated at freeze recovery round 3: each identity is also stated in that record, member by member, with its basis entry.
